edition: Amazon S3 REST API via boto3 1.43.114 / botocore service model (ListObjectsV2, ListObjectVersions, HeadBucket, GetBucketVersioning, HeadObject, GetObject; STS AssumeRole)

operations.name: check_connection
operations.description: HeadBucket, ListObjectsV2(MaxKeys=1) per allowed prefix, GetBucketVersioning

operations.name: sync_page
operations.description: object listing under one allowed prefix: ListObjectsV2 with ContinuationToken, or ListObjectVersions with delete markers as delete events when use_versions

operations.name: fetch_document
operations.description: HeadObject size check then GetObject (optional VersionId) under the size cap; keys outside allowed prefixes rejected

limitations: Verified only against botocore stubbed responses; no AWS account or bucket was available (an emulator would not count as AWS verification either)
Object ACLs and bucket policies are not read; access is decided by the connection's bucket/prefix grant
S3 event notifications are not consumed; change detection is listing-based (plus delete markers when use_versions)
Objects larger than max_object_bytes are refused, not partially read; no multipart/range download
SSE-KMS objects need kms:Decrypt on the connection identity; not tested
